Madam/ Sir, 
 
Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015  
Outcome of Interaction with Institutional Investors  
 
With reference to letter No. CC/S&B/AND/2026-27/416 dated 08.09.2026 regarding 
interaction with the institutional investors/ analysts, we inform that the representatives 
of State Bank of India had investor interaction on 15th September 2026 at Gurugram, 
organised by Jefferies. List of the participants is placed as Annexure. 
 
Only information available in the public domain was given to the investors. 
 
 
 
Yours faithfully,
